CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rough_questionnaire_submissions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  customerName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  customerEmail VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  customerPhone VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  customerAddress VARCHAR(500),
  mode VARCHAR(20),
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
  notes TEXT,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rough_questionnaire_rooms (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  submissionId INT NOT NULL,
  roomKey VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  details JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rough_questionnaire_trade_selections (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  submissionId INT NOT NULL,
  tradeKey VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  selectedPhotoIds JSON,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rough_inspiration_photos (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  tradeKey VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  photoUrl VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  subtitle VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  isActive INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
